architecture: Freqtrade Backtesting subclass uses upstream event loop, Order, LocalTrade, Wallets and serialization. IStrategy owns causal raw signal/candidate state. Imported reference pure indicator/risk/exit functions only; reference simulate() never called for historical results.

semantic_resolutions.H4: Latest complete UTC 4H with close_time <= decision boundary; full prehistory SMA20-seeded EMA, 100 completed H4 warmup; no segment reset
semantic_resolutions.funding: (entry, settlement <= exit_funding_through]; entry-equality excluded, exit-equality included. Protocol scenario both sides pay adverse 1bp/8h on raw entry. Actual-covered scenario uses signed real rate times hourly mark open proxy; missing actual rate is error, not zero. Admission uses prespecified adverse funding, not future rate.
semantic_resolutions.tail: Causal entries retained. Report-time censor every entry with entry+6h open unavailable, even if earlier SL/TP happened. Force exits never principal PnL.
semantic_resolutions.candidate: Invalidations first, then raw signal: no_target before suppression; single active candidate or native open position; no queue or same-hour reversal; lock SL/TP at t0; expiry strict3h
semantic_resolutions.fills: Market execution overrides supported subclass methods to permit adverse fills beyond OHLC rather than native clipping. SL/TP reach uses raw OHLC only. SL gap first, 6h timeout next, then SL before TP; TP gaps fixed target.
semantic_resolutions.intrabar_timestamp: Native ledger exit proxy bar_end-1ms, funding_through=bar_open. Open gap/timeouts exact open.
semantic_resolutions.reserve: Explicit entry reserve0.01% included in native entry fee field as fee+reserve, split in independent ledger.
semantic_resolutions.hour03: H1 D0/D1/D2 remain explicitly hourly-open proxies. Sparse existing minute coverage cannot produce whole-period :03 portfolio; produce coverage/gap analysis, do not interpolate or treat H1 open as :03. No historical notification receipts means actual delay cannot be claimed.

adoption: Exactly original pre-specified D0/D1 validation and quarterly/count/stress screen; actual funding portion is diagnostic, not substitute for required full validation. Failure => reject this frozen candidate; insufficient count => insufficient evidence separately. No live adoption.
